name: yt-cleaner
description: YT Cleaner keeps original YouTube titles and can hide notifications, Shorts, comments, related videos, and playlists.

scripts.check: node --check content.js && node --check interceptor.js && node --check popup.js
scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));if (manifest.manifest_version !== 3) throw new Error('Manifest V3 required'); if (!Array.isArray(manifest.content_scripts) || !manifest.content_scripts.length) throw new Error('content_scripts must be defined'); console.log('Manifest OK');"
